verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API platform with an API reference on Redocly, so a downloadable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent file, and the probe found every common spec path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returns 404. Rendered API reference pages alone do not show that a machine-readable spec can be downloaded.
